key_notes: Key 1 (t=2.14s): Initial archival pose of trumpet; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=3.27s): Mid-sequence articulation of trumpet; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=4.5s): Peak dynamic extension of trumpet over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=5.74s): Follow-through and settle of trumpet with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of trumpet (2.14s..5.74s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
